description: A pinwheel-like star formed by four small squares arranged around a central cross, with pointed tips extending at the top, bottom, left and right. Diagonal lines divide each square into triangles.
A large circle holds a smaller rounded sphere-like form tucked into its lower left, with a curved band sweeping around the upper right of the inner form.
A rounded diamond outline with softly bulging sides surrounds a smaller sharp-cornered diamond at its centre.
A bone-shaped outline with two rounded lobes runs diagonally from the upper right to the left, and a separate small ring sits at the lower right.
Two outlined upward-pointing forms stand side by side: a larger inverted V at the left and a single slanted bar at the right, like mountain peaks.
An isometric cube outline shows its top face and two side faces meeting at a central vertical edge.
A wide dome with a scalloped underside, like an umbrella canopy, with a curved stem dropping from its centre and hooking at the bottom.
Three small rings stack in a vertical column at the left beside two stacked capsule bars at the right, the upper bar longer than the lower.
A wireframe cube drawn in isometric line work sits at the centre of a large circle.
A thick open C-shaped ring encircles a small ring at its centre, with a second small ring sitting in the opening of the C at the right.
A thick open C-shaped ring holds a bold X at its centre.
Two lowercase letters C sit side by side inside a large circle.
A large crescent curves from the top around the left to the bottom, with a smaller crescent-moon shape nested inside its lower right.
A teardrop-shaped speech bubble with its pointed tail at the bottom holds four short strokes radiating like sparks around an empty centre.
A round speech bubble with its tail at the lower right holds a camera with a raised top bump and a round lens.
A stepped equalizer of short capsule bars: four along the bottom row, two above them at the right, and one at the top right.
Three upward arrows of different heights cluster together, the tallest at the centre, a medium one at the left and the shortest at the lower right.
A lifebuoy: an outer circle holds a ring divided into four segments around a central circle.
A cursive lowercase d slants to the right, surrounded by three four-pointed sparkle stars of different sizes.
A lowercase d sits inside a rounded square, its tall stem merging with the top edge of the square at the right.
A game-controller-like face with two round eyes sits inside a rectangular speech bubble whose tail points to the lower right.
A round speech bubble with a small tail at the lower left sits inside a larger speech-bubble outline whose lower left corner is squared.
A whale-shaped hull with a raised tail at the right carries a stepped stack of container blocks on its back.
The character 豆 in blocky strokes: a top bar, a rectangle holding a smaller rectangle, and angled legs standing on a base bar.
A basketball: a circle crossed by curved seam lines sweeping across its face.
Four diamonds arranged in two tiers form an open box, with a hexagonal base beneath the lower pair.
A water-drop outline holds an infinity loop across its middle and a short curved smile beneath it.
A wireframe network of six round nodes joined by crossing straight lines into a flattened polygon.
Italic block letters E and A side by side, the E built from slanted stacked bars and the A peaked at the top right.
A circle split across its middle by two close parallel horizontal lines.
A wave-like swirl: a large curl wraps from the top around the right and turns inward into a hooked inner wave at the lower left.
A thick outlined Y shape with a vertical stroke above its fork and two short diagonal strokes radiating from its lower sides.
A capital letter B with two rounded bowls, the lower bowl slightly wider than the upper.
A cluster of overlapping rounded lobes forms a flower-like knot, with straight lines dividing it into sections.
A rounded E: a circle-like shape with curved top and bottom edges and a rounded central bar, open on the right.
Three rows of stacked rounded bars: two full-width bars above and a bottom row split into two shorter bars.
A donkey stands in profile facing left with a raised pointed ear, a long straight back and a tail flicking down at the right. Its four legs are blocky and straight.
A five-pointed star drawn as an open outline, with a long diagonal stroke sweeping from the lower left up through its body to the right point.
A large flat-sided hexagon outline holds a smaller rounded hexagon at its centre.
A serif capital letter E with bracketed serifs, a short middle bar marked by a small vertical tick and a flaring lower arm.
An elephant head in profile faces right with a folded ear flap at the upper left and a trunk that curls into a spiral at the lower right.

A round speech bubble with a short tail at the lower left holds a lightning-bolt zigzag across its centre.
A square outline with a notched opening wraps inward in a squared spiral, forming a blocky letter G.
A lowercase f with a curved top and a horizontal crossbar sits inside a rounded square, its stem running down to the bottom edge.
A tall lowercase f with a rounded hook at the top and a short crossbar, drawn as a single outlined letterform.
A faceted heart built from angled planes: a large left panel, a smaller inset panel at the upper right, and a point at the bottom.
A division sign: a long horizontal bar with a ring centred above it and another ring centred below it.

Three equal rings sit in a shallow arc, the middle ring raised slightly above the outer two.
A flame made of layered angled folds: a tall left spike, a shorter middle spike and a right spike rising from a pointed shield-like base.
A diamond arrangement of dots: a vertical column of five rings at the centre flanked by smaller solid dots that shrink toward the sides, with one ring at the far right.
